label: Young Mid-Balance
action: The volume segment. Recurring deposits, auto-debit, card upgrades - test offers here before rolling them out.

label: Young Low-Balance
action: Balance-building first: step-up recurring deposits, salary account pitch, digital engagement.

label: Near-Zero Balance
action: Spends more than it holds. Retention and activation before any credit pitch: balance-building offers, fee waivers, re-onboarding.

label: Established Mid-Balance
action: Longest tenure and the highest balances in this base. Term deposits, portfolio review, retirement and protection products.
